capabilities: Mirror Trello boards into Kanban-plugin Markdown board notes on a configurable interval
Trigger an immediate sync via a Sync now command
Render card due-complete state, labels, members, descriptions and checklists in the board note
Push card names, lane moves and checklist checked states back to Trello with optional two-way sync
Link each card back to its Trello card using hidden ID markers
disambiguation: Not the Kanban board plugin itself; it writes board files that the separate Kanban plugin renders.
extras: Two-way sync is experimental and off by default. The README warns that the Trello API key/token stored in data.json should be gitignored, and notes the plugin works on mobile because it uses Obsidian's requestUrl instead of fetch.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or edit Trello boards as native Kanban board notes inside a vault.

relations.evidence: Mirrors Trello boards into native Obsidian Kanban-plugin boards (requires the Kanban plugin to actually render them)
Defaults to one-way sync: Trello is the source of truth

summary: Trello integration that mirrors Trello boards into Kanban-plugin Markdown boards on an interval, with optional two-way editing.
